quality_notes: Anaerobic-digestate framework rows are end-of-waste, quality, storage and nutrient-management requirements rather than quantified emissions reductions.
Decarbonisation-readiness/AD consultation percentages represent stakeholder responses and regulatory decisions, not emissions quantities.

Biological-waste emissions-control rows record emissions inventories, LDAR methods, monitoring/detection examples and permit requirements, not site-specific measured emissions unless a survey result exists.
No PDF-derived values, spreadsheet inference or parcel bindings were introduced.
